harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created an SSH host CA on node1, signed the ed25519 host key with it, configured sshd to present the certificate, and verified a client trusting only the CA (via @cert-authority, no pinned host key) connects successfully — including after a full node restart.
actions_performed: Generated ed25519 CA keypair at /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca (private key root-only, 0600)
Signed /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub as a host certificate (-h) with principals node1,10.100.208.10,localhost and 52-week validity, producing /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub
Added 'HostCertificate /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub' to /etc/ssh/sshd_config (backup taken first) and validated with sshd -t
Restarted ssh service and verified it serves the certificate
Verified a client using only an '@cert-authority' known_hosts entry (no pinned host key) connects with StrictHostKeyChecking=yes

Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline, restarted node1 via 'reboot', polled until exec was available again, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified sshd cert presentation and CA-trust client connection after reboot

evidence.requirement: Host key signed by the CA and sshd configured to present it
evidence.summary: ssh-keygen -s signed the ed25519 host key producing ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub; sshd -t passed and ssh service restarted active; ssh-keygen -L confirms cert type, signing CA, and principals

evidence.requirement: Client connects trusting only the CA, without host-key pinning
evidence.summary: ssh with UserKnownHostsFile containing only an @cert-authority line (no pinned host key) shows 'Host ... is known and matches the ED25519-CERT host certificate', authenticates, and runs a command
Captured boot_id 6ab98831-2739-47d3-b99c-0784ebb8b49e, ssh active, HostCertificate directive present, cert file details, CA dir contents
Backgrounded 'sleep 1; reboot' via sudo -n returned REBOOT_TRIGGERED before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity (actual restart, not just service restart)
evidence.summary: Node briefly refused connections (going down), then came back with boot_id 8bf7baef-e848-4e73-bc71-958016ef3303, differing from the pre-restart boot_id

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of SSH CA/certificate setup and CA-trust connectivity
evidence.summary: After reboot, sshd still active with HostCertificate configured and serving the same signed certificate; a client trusting only the CA reconnected successfully (CONNECTED_AFTER_REBOOT) confirming end-to-end recovery
